items.title: Webview desktop shell: the slices after slice 1
items.body: Slice 1 LANDED on next @1a894115 (lane commit 29f38354): `std::window` (`Window::builder(url).title(..).size(w, h).open()`, `Window::close`), runtime crate `crates/vilan-rt-webview` (wry =0.57.2, tao =0.37.2) outside the workspace with its own lockfile, notices and CI job `webview` (GitHub-hosted ubuntu, xvfb end-to-end proof), linked by use, the JS backend refuses by name. Verified on Linux only; macOS and Windows are cross-linted, never run. Remaining slices, in order: deep links; menus; notifications; secure token storage; tray; multiple windows; packaging and installers; porting kolt's Electron shell; verification on real macOS and Windows machines. Also open: a `desktop` entry kind (a manifest backend key plus run/build/workspace rules), deferred from slice 1 as a larger design.
